strings.name: Sridhar Vembu
strings.summary: Indian entrepreneur and engineer Sridhar Vembu helped found AdventNet, later Zoho, developing enterprise software, internal research and rural talent. He moved from group CEO to chief scientist in 2025. Products and education initiatives depend on cofounders and teams.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Group and division roles, renaming and founding, and award announcement and ceremony are distinguished. Statements on costs and pay remain attributed.
strings.influence.rationale: Cofounded Zoho and developed enterprise software, exploring global services, rural training and distributed operations.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education and early work
strings.facts.f1.value: IIT Madras electrical engineering BTech in 1989; Princeton master’s and doctorate, the latter in 1994; joined Qualcomm in 1994.
strings.facts.f2.label: Institutional governance
strings.facts.f2.value: Chaired IIITDM Kancheepuram from August 25, 2023 to August 24, 2026; a former role at the review cutoff.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Enterprise software and research
strings.highlights.h1.text: Moved from network management to enterprise applications, advancing products through internal research; team achievements are not individual inventions.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Talent and rural offices
strings.highlights.h2.text: Zoho Schools training and rural offices explore talent development; the training program is distinct from a university degree.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Business-pressure statements reported
strings.timeline.t1.text: Indian Express reports his statements on pausing customary raises and controlling AI costs; efforts to avoid layoffs are not a guarantee of none.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Announces move to chief scientist
strings.timeline.t2.text: Announces a research focus, with Shailesh Kumar Davey succeeding as group CEO; division leaders hold separate roles.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Named for Padma Shri
strings.timeline.t3.text: Government announcement lists him in Trade and Industry; award announcement is not proof of ceremony attendance.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Company opens Tenkasi office
strings.timeline.t4.text: Zoho history records rural office expansion, reflecting exploration of talent and location strategy.
strings.timeline.t5.title: AdventNet renamed Zoho
strings.timeline.t5.text: Company becomes Zoho Corporation, distinct from its 1996 founding and 2005 cloud-product brand phase.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Zoho Schools begins training
strings.timeline.t6.text: Company anniversary history records six initial school-leavers receiving training and apprenticeships; the number is historical.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Cofounds AdventNet
strings.timeline.t7.text: Starts the software company with brothers and friends, building on engineering experience.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Earns doctorate and joins Qualcomm
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completes Princeton doctorate then enters wireless engineering; this is not a postdoctoral research appointment.
